end.summary:
Practised sorting numbers as odd or even using pairs of dancers/players.
Identified 6 as even and 7 as odd by checking for a leftover.
Predicted odd + odd, even + even, and odd + even outcomes correctly in two attempts.
Used the ones digit rule for 247 and 47, but still chose odd because those numbers contain an odd digit.
end.parentNote: Jiya practised making pairs and checking whether one is left over. The pairing method worked well for 6, 7, and for explaining why 3 + 5 = 8 is even; the odd/even sum patterns were also answered correctly. Jiya mixed up the ones-digit rule by focusing on any odd digit, and this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to sort numbers by looking only at the last digit: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 are even; 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 are odd.
